cohort: 124 pregnant obese women (BMI > 30 kg/m2) with gestational age between 13-24 months, and normal fasting blood glucose and blood pressure.
finding: Obesity in pregnancy is associated with a range of serious maternal and fetal outcomes, including miscarriages, stillbirths, and neonatal anomalies.
mod_finding: Nearly 70% of the obese pregnant women underwent a cesarean section, often due to pre-eclampsia, prolonged or dysfunctional labor, and fetal distress.
